name: Deore XT crankset
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 721.6 g for FC-M8000-B2, 175 mm crank arms and 36/26T chainrings, excluding the bottom bracket and chain/bash guard. The weight heading explicitly specifies 175 mm without BB; the selected model and chainring configuration are retained without converting to a 170 mm estimate. This B2 version has the manufacturer-specified 3 mm outboard chainline and matching frame/derailleur arrangement; standard FC-M8000-2 weights are not transferred.
